sql: select count(*) as "count" from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and ("ciudad" = $1 or ("tipo" is null or "tipo" != $2))

select * from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and ("ciudad" = $1 or ("tipo" is null or "tipo" != $2)) order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $3 offset $4
